comment: Interim review (lab-c, round 3). c1 (A, B, C triangle, side 5, sides 4.5-5.5): my run 2026-11-19/r1/lab-c/020 is an independent equilateral A-B-C triangle at side 5, at rest, T=2, with the P-0005 coefficients (the same predictor form as P-0007).
